propertySets.name: Pset_RailTypeRail
propertySets.definition: Properties common to IfcRail types and occurrences with PredefinedType set to RAIL.

properties.name: PositionInTrack
properties.definition: Indicates the relative position of the element in track, which lies to the left or right as facing in the direction of increasing stationing values.

properties.name: TechnicalStandard
properties.definition: The technical standard which the element should comply with.

properties.name: RailDeliveryState
properties.definition: The delivery state of rail, which indicates the final treatment at the end in manufacturing.

properties.name: RailCondition
properties.definition: Assessment of the condition of the rail at point of installation.

properties.name: DrillOnRail
properties.definition: Indicates if the manufactured rail is drilled at its extremities or not. It can have holes on one, both or none of its extremities.

properties.name: RailElementaryLength
properties.definition: The standardised length of rail supplied from the manufacturer.

properties.name: IsStainless
properties.definition: Indicates whether the rail is stainless or not.

properties.name: InstallationPlan
properties.definition: Reference to external information source about installation or construction plan of the element.
